data.body: RCA: the SSM rotation runbook treated SSM as the only post-rotation write target, but several GitHub Actions secrets are operational mirrors of SSM-backed credentials. Rotating only SSM leaves scheduled/CI workflows reading stale GitHub secret values until manually synced. RED evidence: tests/unit/test_secret_rotation_runbook.py initially failed because infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md had no Actions mirror inventory or SSM-to-gh secret set commands. Fix adds that inventory, copy-paste sync commands, and a timestamp-based drift-audit note; no new CI-provider-only mechanism added.
